items.title: View a Workspace
items.desc:
This tool enables users to search for and access workspaces.


A workspace can be accessed by entering the Workspace ID (WSID), providing a reason for access, and selecting Continue. If the user has the appropriate permissions, they will be redirected to the client’s workspace with super administrator privileges.


Alternatively, users may locate a workspace by searching using various criteria and selecting the Access option. Upon selecting Access, the user will be prompted to provide a reason before proceeding. Once submitted, and if permissions are validated, the user will be redirected to the client’s workspace with super administrator access.


In addition to facilitating workspace access, this page also provides valuable insights. Users can select View Details for a workspace from the search results to review key information, including active modules, check counts by check date, and a list of administrators associated with the workspace.

items.title: Sync Start Date
items.desc:
This configuration allows users to define a start date from which the sync process will retrieve data.


This setting is particularly useful in scenarios where historical data contains inconsistencies or errors that the client does not wish to correct. By specifying a start date, the sync can be limited to only include data from that point forward, avoiding issues tied to legacy data.


Example Use Case:
A client uses a single child support garnishment code for multiple child support records per employee. This is not supported, as each record requires a unique identifier. To resolve this, the client may update future payroll configurations by assigning distinct codes (e.g., Child Support 1 (CS1), Child Support 2 (CS2), etc.). By setting the sync start date to align with this change, only compliant data will be processed, preventing partial failures caused by duplicate records.


Please note that once a start date is configured, the sync process will only retrieve data from that date forward. Even if checksum tables are truncated to force a full sync, data prior to the specified start date will not be included.
items.config:
To request this setting, please send up a case with the below information:
WSID: The workspace ID(s) this setting needs to be configured for
Sync Start Date: The stating date the sync will look back from.
Reason: Detailed explanation as to why we are enabling this setting to ensure it fits the customer's needs.
